about: Caption News house look (fixed reel to reel). Ported from lemo-opuscar styles/caption-news (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 LemoLab, https://github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar) and adapted to a vertical talking head.
world: the speaker's face as shot is the ground; huge captions are the lead actor: each line slams in 2-3 chunks on the onsets of their first words, one keyword per caption on a honey block that wipes left to right; short full-screen cutaways on the ledger sheet (document on a dark desk, lit grid, ruled list) carry the facts the speaker names; a channel bug born from a title sting and a source tag on every document shot
layout: 1080x1920 at 30 fps. The speaker's face sits y 470-1080 (tight and wide plates), so the caption card lives in the lower band: left aligned at x 64, max width 916 (right edge <= 980, Instagram UI ~100 px), the last line's slab bottom on y 1680 (>= 220 px clear at the bottom), lines stacked upward, each line a dark slab with its chunks. Bug top left at x 64, y 126 (>= 120 px clear at the top), 72 px high; source tag under it (y 214 + 286). Title sting page = the bottom band y 1140-1920 over the speaker's live plate (the 16:9 original wipes over the left 45 %), never above the speaker's chin. Cutaway cards are full screen and keep their content between y 380 and 1650.

type.captions: Inter Tight 900 (Latin + Cyrillic; the stand-in for Noto Sans SC 900), sentence case as spoken, tracking -0.02 em, ivory #F7F5EF on an ink slab rgba(14,14,12,.84) per line (the slab reads on any clothing: no gradient on the speaker's plate), keyword ink #0E0E0C on honey #FFC21A; 84 px (verdict 100-105 px, hook up to 150 px), shrunk to fit 916 px but never under 60 px (the house floor: >= 48 px)
type.chrome: bug, source tag, chips: Inter Tight 900 caps 48 px (the original's 17-26 px is under the 48 px floor)
type.numbers: Inter Tight 900 with tabular digits (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums), the original num() fixed-width cells
type.substitutions: Noto Sans SC 900 / 500 (no Cyrillic) -> Inter Tight 900 / 600; Inter Tight stays Inter Tight. Fonts from templates/fonts (OFL, Cyrillic + Latin woff2), copied into assets/fonts per reel.
type.never: a second-language line under the caption (under-48 px lines are banned), em dashes, words the speaker did not say, SVG filter:url()

palette.meaning: honey = the point / the keyword / the bug; red = the bad thing (notification badges); ivory = everything else; grey = labels

motion.chunk_slam: scale 1.3 -> 1 in 0.13 s, back.out(1.6), opacity full in 0.04 s, at the onset of the chunk's first word (the original spaces chunks 0.12 s apart at the caption start; a talking head must not show words before the speaker says them, except the frame-4 hook)
motion.keyword_wipe: honey block scaleX 0 -> 1 from the left in 0.12 s, 0.05 s after its chunk lands; the text turns ink at +0.08 s
motion.hook: frame 4 (0.13 s): the first line's chunks slam 0.13 s apart, the keyword in a giant honey block
motion.card_in: cutaway cards slide in from the right in 0.18 s with honey speed streaks; a slow push 1.0 -> 1.03 inside
motion.grid: panels rise 80 px staggered 0.1 s, each lights (honey border, honey label, a red badge pops) on the word that names it
motion.list: rows: the numeral slams, the bar grows from the left in 0.3 s on its word; the previous bar turns ivory
motion.doc: the cover on a dark desk tilted -1.5 deg, push 0.94 -> 1.0 (never above 1:1 of book2x), highlighter rectangles (multiply, honey) swept left to right in 0.3-0.45 s on the words the speaker says, then the title re-set in a honey block beside it
motion.sting: honey ruled page wipes over the bottom band in 0.2 s, rules draw staggered, red double margin draws down, the title slams word by word, a chip follows; the page wipes off left in 0.18 s and the bug fades in
motion.cuts: hard cuts on the word onsets (the original cuts on a 120 BPM half-beat grid under a score; there is no score here)

sound.rule: the voice + SFX only, never a bed. Every graphic action that ENTERS gets a short sound: the hook hit on frame 4, a pop under each keyword wipe, whooshes into each card, paper on the document, marker on each highlighter sweep, pops as grid panels light, clicks as list rows land, a soft boom under the verdict.

vary_per_reel: which line gets the hook, which facts get cutaways (document / grid / list / a chart only with true, sourced numbers), the bug text, the keyword of each caption, the ending (verdict on the speaker's face, back to the hook, last card)
